entries.changes: Added Severian Lowell and builds for 53 of 62 agents, all from Prydwen. Drive Disc sets and W-Engines were refreshed from Prydwen (103 W-Engines, 30 sets) with bundled images. Off-specialty W-Engines are allowed as stat sticks, agents are sorted by release date, and substat PEN is now Flat PEN.
Initial release with the full agent roster, Drive Discs, W-Engines, and the Hoshimi Miyabi DPS build.
